extracted.intended_audience: NLP researchers and ML practitioners working on long-form story generation
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating and building models to generate coherent, complete, length-controlled long-form stories; includes architectural choices (context weighting, structural tokens) and empirical evaluation (coherence, completeness, relevance, repetitiveness, zero-shot/generalization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures whether the generated long story maintains logical and narrative consistency across its length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The paper claims LongStory outperforms baselines in coherence; the model uses a long and short-term contexts weight calibrator (CWC) to acknowledge distinct roles of long-term Memory and short-term Cheating, which is intended to improve coherence over long spans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness / Proper Ending
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the story is brought to a proper, satisfying ending and the narrative is completed rather than left unfinished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abstract emphasizes human authors always bring stories to a proper ending — an ability current LMs lack — and LongStory aims to produce complete stories with proper endings; completeness is an explicit evaluation target.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length Control
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to control and produce stories of intended or varied target lengths without losing quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: LongStory is described as 'length-controlled long story generation' and is trained on three datasets with varied average story lengths to handle different target lengths effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree to which generated content stays on-topic and relevant to the story premise or prior context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: LongStory is reported to outperform baselines in relevance; relevance is one of the named evaluation dimensions in the abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repetitiveness (Low Repetition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extent to which the model avoids repeating content, phrases, or events excessively over long outputs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repetitiveness is explicitly listed as an evaluation axis where LongStory outperforms other baselines, indicating reduced undesirable repetition is a target metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generalization / Zero-shot Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability of the model to perform well on datasets or story-length distributions not seen during training (zero-shot testing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The authors perform zero-shot tests on each dataset to assess the model's ability to predict outcomes beyond its training data; zero-shot/generalization performance is used as an evaluation criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context Weight Calibration (CWC) — architecture guideline
rubrics_metrics.description: Model should explicitly adjust weights for long-term context (Memory) and short-term context (Cheating), acknowledging their distinct roles in long story generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CWC is presented as a methodological contribution: it adjusts weights for long-term Memory and short-term Cheating to improve long-form generation. This is a recommended architectural/component-level criterion for systems aiming at long coherent stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long Story Structural Positions (LSP) — structural tokenization
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ discourse tokens or structural position indicators to convey the structural positions of a long story (e.g., discourse-level positions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: LSP is introduced as a method that uses discourse tokens to convey structural positions in a long story; this is suggested as a production guideline to help models maintain structure over long outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empirical Validation via Baseline and Variant Comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate proposed methods by comparing performance against strong baselines and model variants/ablations across multiple datasets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The abstract notes LongStory outperforms baselines including Plotmachine and that the methodology is validated by comparing performance with variants of the model; benchmarking against baselines and ablations is therefore an expected evaluation practice.
